snippet.title: ZOMVAC – Official Trailer | What’s Really Happening in This Hotel?
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Silverbirch Inn — a haunted hotel in Albion, Idaho crawling with strange energy, restless spirits, and corrupted vacuum cleaners stalking the halls.

This is the Official Gameplay Trailer for the ZOMVAC Prototype Demo, featuring the complete Floor 1 of the hotel. Explore the Lobby, Cafeteria, hallways, early hazards, and interactable objects while switching between Evan and Maya, the two playable characters available in this early build.

Inspired by nostalgic 2000s adventure-horror games, ZOMVAC blends exploration, puzzles, hazard avoidance, and light survival tension in a cute-but-creepy pixel-art style.

👻 WHAT’S INCLUDED IN THE PROTOTYPE DEMO

Full Floor 1 experience

Two playable characters: Evan & Maya

Ghost-vacuum patrols & hazards

Early puzzles & interactions

Updated UI + prototype minimap

Foundational movement and item systems

This demo represents the foundation of the full game.

Play the demo now:
👉 Steam (Prototype Demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853050/Zomvac_Prototype_Demo/

Wishlist the full game here:
👉 Steam (Full Game Page): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845480/Zomvac/

🔧 COMING SOON — FLOOR 2 & NEW FEATURES

The next major update expands the prototype with:

✨ Floor 2 Content Update

Silver Keys

Guest Rescue system

Spirit Shards & optional side quests

Modern, Retro, and Super Retro save modes

New hazards

New rooms & puzzles

Major visual upgrades

And let’s just say…
Floor 2 will be your lucky day. 😉

🎮 NEW SUPPORT & IMPROVEMENTS COMING

Steam Deck support

Full controller support (PS4/PS5, Xbox, Switch Pro)

Accessibility options

UI scaling improvements

Performance fixes

More content, polish, and surprises

🧹 ABOUT THE FULL GAME

ZOMVAC is a 2D pixel horror adventure set across six haunted floors of the Silverbirch Inn. Explore, rescue guests, unlock floors, survive vacuum monsters, solve quests, and uncover the hotel’s supernatural mystery.

This prototype is the first playable slice of the journey.

🚀 SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT — KICKSTARTER LIVE NOW

Help us finish the haunted hotel demo and expand the project with new floors, bosses, events, and platform versions.

👉 Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kodybodstudios/zomvac-help-us-finish-the-haunted-hotel-demo

Join the community:
👉 Discord: https://discord.gg/m73vKYAfpb

📰 PRESS & CONTENT CREATORS

Coverage, reactions, and interviews are welcome.
Contact: kodybodstudios@gmail.com
